summary: Remote-controlled PTY backdoor with Anthropic credential harvesting
details: sextant-cli-darwin-arm64@0.0.1-rc35 ships a macOS arm64 Go binary that opens a persistent WebSocket to hardcoded wss://relay.sextant.top and posts to https://relay.sextant.top/install. The binary links a PTY library (github.com/creack/pty) and a WebSocket client (github.com/coder/websocket), giving a remote party the ability to drive shell commands into a PTY on the installer's host — a remote-shell backdoor. The same binary enumerates Anthropic Claude credentials on the installer: it references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, matches the regex sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,} against local content, and validates candidate keys against https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models. It additionally performs host reconnaissance by fetching http://ip-api.com/json/ with fields covering ISP, org, AS, proxy/hosting flags, geolocation, and public IP, and contains strings for fetching and executing https://claude.ai/install.sh together with sudo/curl/brew/bun invocation fragments, giving the remote operator a runtime code-drop path. Publisher metadata points the license to https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, matching the binary's observed capability set.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
